value.rationale: A natural family of two-dimensional real moment-angle spaces arises by deleting a vertex of a polygon; its reversal symmetry is canonical. Unlike known homotopy wedge ranks or generic equivariant Euler/fixed-point facts, this determines exact homeomorphism types, distinguishing an exceptional disk from a uniform family of nonorientable surfaces and identifying boundary/crosscap growth and fundamental group for all sizes. The independent gluing and nonorientability mechanisms make the classification structurally motivated rather than arbitrary finite recomputation.
